Profiles

List engines / profiles:

dlsurfer engines
dlsurfer engines --alternatives

Profile

Purpose

core

FastSurfer VINN + CC + Cereb + Hyp + recon-surf

core-lesion

Default lesion path: LIT fill → core → lit-post

core-lesion-native

Native --lesion_mask (no seg/surf split)

seg-quick

--seg_only --tal_reg (volume + talairach)

seg-quick-synthseg

SynthSeg volume alt

strip / register-* / bias-deepn4

Utilities

fs-long, subfields-ha, nuclei-bs-thal

FS gap-fills

fs-clinical, preprocess-synthsr

Odd contrast / salvage

atlas-*, --atlas dk

Extra parc

structure-claustrum, structure-hippunfold, …

Specialty

surf-dl-topofit*

TopoFit WM (gate: passed machine check)

surf-dl-v2c, sphere-sugar, thickness-fast

Still gated open

Experimental profiles need a passed gate or --allow-experimental.
